You're about to send to $COUNT$ recipients.

To stay within Outlook's sending limits and protect your account from being flagged, OutMass automatically paces this send (about 30/min), so it will take roughly $MIN$ minutes and continues in the background.

For large cold lists, deliverability is best if you spread the send over several days (a few hundred per day) using Schedule.

Continue?
